mapper.select: select branchInfo.BRANCHID branchCode, branchInfo.BANKNAME branchName, '${startDate}' startDate, '${endDate}' endDate, branchInfo.prinAmt, tempInt.YIELD prdYield, FIN_RATE_INFO.BASIS prdBasis, tempSale.YIELD saleRate, tempSale.BASIS saleBasis, tempOSale.YIELD oSaleRate, tempOSale.BASIS oSaleBasis from ( select PRODID, BRANCHID, BANKNAME, SUM(NVL(BRANCHACCOUNTAMOUNT,0)) prinAmt from INTERF_BRANCH where to_date(INTERF_BRANCH.CDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = to_date(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and INTERF_BRANCH.INTERF_ID IN ('449189','449195','449192') group by PRODID, BRANCHID, BANKNAME ) branchInfo inner join FIN_PRODUCT on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = branchInfo.PRODID and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

select trdProductDealAmt.BRANCH branch, to_char(trdProductDealAmt.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') startDate, to_char(trdProductDealAmt.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') endDate, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.CUSTOM_LEVEL customLevel, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.AMT_MIN amtMin, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.AMT_MAX amtMax, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.TERM_MAX termMax, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.TERM_MIN termMin, trdProductDealAmt.TRADE_AMT tdyPrinAmt, PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.THEORY_RATE yield, PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.ACT_RATE actYield, PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.THEORY_INT intAmt, trdProductDealInt.TRADE_AMT actIntAmt from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL trdProductDealAmt on TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = trdProductDealAmt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID and trdProductDealAmt.PS in (#{psSH}, #{psDQ}) left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL trdProductDealInt on TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = trdProductDealInt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID and trdProductDealAmt.FINPROD_ID = trdProductDealInt.FINPROD_ID and trdProductDealInt.PS = #{psInt} left join PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL on trdProductDealInt.TRADE_ID = PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID left join PRD_LAYER_PARAM on PRD_LAYER_PARAM.FINPROD_ID = trdProductDealAmt.FINPROD_ID where TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

select MST_FEEINFO.FEE_NAME feeName, MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE feeType, to_char(TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') startDate, to_char(TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') endDate, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SHARE_AMT prinamt, PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BASIS basis, PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.THEORY_RATE feeRate, PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.THEORY_INT feeAmt, PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.ACT_RATE actFeeRate, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_AMT actFeeAmt, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.REMARK remark from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL
INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.FINPROD_ID AND FIN_CASH_INFO.BRANCH = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.BRANCH AND FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} AND FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_2 != #{cashType2} left join MST_FEEINFO on FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL on TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_2 = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_TYPE2 and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS = #{psFee} left join PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL on TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID where TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

select BRANCH branchCode, PRIN_AMT prinAmt, ACC_INT_AMT profitAmt, INT_AMT actProfitAmt, ACC_SALEFEE_AMT saleFeeAmt, SALEFEE_AMT actSaleFeeAmt, ACC_SALEFEE2_AMT oSaleFeeAmt, SALEFEE2_AMT actOSaleFeeAmt from PA_BRANCH_SALE_DETAIL where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

select to_char(deal.vdate,'YYYY-MM-DD') vdate, to_char(decode(deal.ps,#{psC20},total.mdate,deal.mdate), 'YYYY-MM-DD') mdate, pa.theory_int interest, deal.int_amt actInterest, pa.remain_prin_amt remainPrinAmt, deal.PRIN_AMT reduceAmt, pla.prod_style from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal inner join pa_trd_product_deal pa on pa.trade_id = deal.trade_id inner join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL total on total.totle_trade_id = deal.totle_trade_id left join prd_layer_param pla on deal.finprod_id = pla.finprod_id where deal.totle_trade_id = #{totleTradeId} and deal.ps IN (#{psC15},#{psC7})

select a.finprod_id finprodId, c.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, c.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, c.finprod_name finprodName, a.totle_trade_id busiNo, a.ps dealType, f.DEAL_MODE dealMode, e.ccy, a.vdate, a.mdate, a.settle_date payDate, a.prin_amt mCusRevAmt, a.prin_amt reduceAmt, b.Theory_Int cusProfit, b.interest actCusProfit, f.is_lay isLay, e.remark from trd_fin_product_deal_total a left join pa_trd_fin_product_deal_total b on a.totle_trade_id = b.totle_trade_id left join fin_product c on a.finprod_id = c.finprod_id and c.finprod_type2 = #{finprodType} left join fin_product_add f on a.finprod_id = f.finprod_id
left join trd_product_deal e on a.totle_trade_id = e.totle_trade_id and a.ps = e.ps where a.totle_trade_id = #{tradeId} and rownum = 1

select to_char(deal.vdate,'YYYY-MM-DD') vdate, to_char(deal.mdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') mdate, nvl(pa.theory_int,0) interest, nvl(deal.int_amt,0) actInterest, pa.remain_prin_amt remainPrinAmt, deal.PRIN_AMT reduceAmt, pla.prod_style from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal inner join pa_trd_product_deal pa on pa.trade_id = deal.trade_id left join prd_layer_param pla on deal.finprod_id = pla.finprod_id where deal.totle_trade_id = #{totleTradeId} and deal.ps IN (#{psC4},#{psC5},#{psC20})
